## Problem and change

You should describe the problem, the behavior changed, and related issues.

## Validation

You should list checks run and their results, plus checks not run and why. Include relevant accessibility, privacy, recovery, or compatibility evidence. For new components and component patterns, you should record Draft status, focused accessibility and visual evidence, unperformed checks, and the explicit design review decision.

## Remaining risks or follow-up

You should describe any limitations, dependencies, or manual review still needed. Do not include credentials, private information, or production data.
